subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Test Parallelization
description: A fast breakdown of Test Parallelization for builders.

hook.text: A suite of 2,000 tests runs sequentially. It takes one hour. Developers avoid running it.

buildup.text: Each test is independent, but they wait in a single-file line like a slow grocery queue.

discovery.text: Parallelization splits tests across multiple workers so they run simultaneously.

twist.text: The main obstacle isn't tooling—it's shared state that makes tests fight each other.

climax.text: After isolating state, they run on eight workers. One hour becomes eight minutes.

punchline.text: Independent tests can run together. Dependent tests never can.

quiz.question: What is the main obstacle to test parallelization?
